title: Chapter 5 — AI Quiz: System Software
instructions: Original AI-authored practice, not an official Cambridge or teacher paper. Answer all questions; written responses are self-marked using the guidance after submission. You can retake the quiz.
description: Original chapter practice: multiple-choice and written questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: Which software translates assembly language into machine code?
What is a purpose of a device driver?

options.text: Enables an operating system to communicate with a device

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Enables an operating system to communicate with a device.

questions.text: Explain one difference between a compiler and an interpreter.

answer.text: A compiler translates a whole program before execution; an interpreter translates and executes statements during execution.

questions.text: State two functions of an operating system.

answer.text: Any other distinct function, e.g. process scheduling, file management or peripheral management.

questions.text: Explain why a linker is needed when building an executable.

answer.text: Combines object code with required library routines or other object modules.

questions.text: Describe a purpose of utility software and give an example.

answer.text: Maintains, protects or manages a computer system.
Example: backup, anti-malware or file compression utility.
